info.name: Stedi Healthcare Claims Claim acknowledgments Payer API

params.name: stediId
params.description:
The Stedi payer ID, a unique identifier Stedi assigns to each payer that will never change. You can find the Stedi payer ID for any supported payer in the [Payer Network](https://www.stedi.com/healthcare/network).

This must be the Stedi payer ID - querying with the primary payer ID or payer ID aliases isn't supported.

items.docs: Retrieve a single payer record by its Stedi payer ID.
